title: Sloth in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tree branch -->
  <rect x='5' y='70' width='90' height='10' rx='5' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <rect x='5' y='70' width='90' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#B07B45'/>
  <!-- sloth body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='20' ry='18' fill='#A0785A'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='13' ry='12' fill='#C9A382'/>
  <!-- legs hanging -->
  <rect x='34' y='68' width='8' height='18' rx='4' fill='#8A6248'/>
  <rect x='58' y='68' width='8' height='18' rx='4' fill='#8A6248'/>
  <!-- claws -->
  <rect x='32' y='82' width='4' height='7' rx='2' fill='#E8D5B7'/>
  <rect x='37' y='82' width='4' height='7' rx='2' fill='#E8D5B7'/>
  <rect x='56' y='82' width='4' height='7' rx='2' fill='#E8D5B7'/>
  <rect x='61' y='82' width='4' height='7' rx='2' fill='#E8D5B7'/>
  <!-- arm over branch -->
  <rect x='66' y='62' width='9' height='17' rx='4.5' fill='#8A6248' transform='rotate(18 70 70)'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='18' ry='16' fill='#B08A6A'/>
  <!-- face mask -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='12' ry='10' fill='#EAD9BE'/>
  <!-- eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='38' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#6B4A33'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='38' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#6B4A33'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='38' r='2' fill='#1E1B33'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='38' r='2' fill='#1E1B33'/>
  <circle cx='43.6' cy='37.3' r='0.7' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='57.6' cy='37.3' r='0.7' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#5A3A26'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M46 47 Q50 50 54 47' stroke='#5A3A26' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- scarf -->
  <path d='M30 55 Q50 63 70 55 L70 61 Q50 69 30 61 Z' fill='#E2444F'/>
  <rect x='60' y='59' width='9' height='16' rx='3' fill='#E2444F' transform='rotate(-10 64 67)'/>
  <rect x='61' y='66' width='7' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#F7A0A6' transform='rotate(-10 64 67)'/>
  <rect x='61' y='71' width='7' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#F7A0A6' transform='rotate(-10 64 67)'/>
  <!-- ear tufts -->
  <path d='M36 26 L39 18 L43 26 Z' fill='#8A6248'/>
  <path d='M57 26 L61 18 L64 26 Z' fill='#8A6248'/>
</svg>
